payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for different models used in cyberbullying detection, including the impact of oversampling and comparisons between DNN and traditional machine learning models.

claims.text: Oversampling the bullying class improved the performance of DNN models significantly across evaluation measures.
DNN models outperformed traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) in cyberbullying detection.
Transfer learning showed low recall but higher precision when applying DNN models trained on one dataset to another.
